item.title: Ajax Tabbed Google Search for Typo3
item.description:
My first Typo3 extension. It’s a front-end plugin that displays a customised Google search engine on your site, using Ajax with tabs for different result types – no page reload needed.

You can download it from the Typo3 Forge (link no longer available). The SVN repository was at svn.typo3.org/TYPO3v4/Extensions/ajax_google_search.
